summary: The Fleet Map is now buildings-only: nodes never draw their own pin any more, and every node is reached by drilling into the building it belongs to. Standalone/off-site node placement is removed (the old 'place on map' button, node drag-to-place, and the Nodes-layer toggle are gone); the side rail is now building-centric, listing every building (placed and unplaced) with status/camera count and an expandable list of that building's floors/areas, with nodes not yet assigned to a building surfaced in a separate 'Appliances' section to assign via a dropdown. The in-app floor editor (FloorEditor) gained three new authoring tools -- Round (elliptical rooms), Door (wall openings carved in both 2D and 3D with a lintel), and Stairs (rotatable straight flights, extruded as rising steps in 3D) -- plus zoom (toolbar + Ctrl/Cmd+wheel), a draggable/dockable tool palette and properties inspector (float or dock left/right, stacking when both dock the same side), and an Esc that now cancels an in-progress wall run instead of exiting the whole editor and losing unsaved walls. The building editor also gained a 'Remove plan' action (new DELETE /api/floors/{id}/image endpoint, services.ClearFloorImage) that clears an area's plan picture back to the blank canvas it started as, at the floor's existing pixel dimensions, while leaving every wall/stair/door and camera placement untouched -- the inverse of uploading a plan, and the only way to un-upload one short of deleting the whole area.
compatibility: No schema migration. Existing floor plans with no design/background are unaffected; ClearFloorImage only regenerates the blank canvas for a floor an operator explicitly clears, and preserves Grid/Scale/WallHeight/Elevation and every placement. Any node previously placed standalone on the map (mapPlaced with no siteId) simply stops being drawn -- its ManagedNode.Lat/Lon/MapPlaced row and the PUT /api/nodes/{id}/position endpoint are untouched at the API layer, so no data is lost and re-wiring a future UI action to it needs no backend change; the operator now assigns it to a building instead to have it represented on the map. New grid JSON fields stairs[]/doors[] are additive and optional -- a floor plan authored before this change simply has empty arrays.
